title: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company files for approval two standard offer contracts for interruptible City-Gate Gas Supply with Fitchburg Operating, LLC, a corporation located in Fitchburg, Massachusetts.
petitioner: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company d/b/a Unitil
filings: The Department hereby approves the Company's two (2) standard offer contracts for IS Service. Commissioners participating were: Besser, Chair; Keating, Connelly, Vasington and Sullivan.
